thread:
Nina: Noticing a similarity/embedding drift affecting new trial tenants since ~09:20 UTC. Search relevance for trial data is returning low-similarity matches. Need comms + quick mitigation.
Owen: Investigating models and routing. Early signal points to a vector normalization change pushed in the small-encoder config yesterday.
Priya: Drafting outbound: short apology, explain were validating a config rollback, offer on-demand reindex and a small credit for trials. Keep wording cautious per legal.
Sam: Can ops hold off broad rollback? We should only touch trial pools first to minimize blast radius.
Owen: Agree. Rolling back trial pool config now. ETA 20m for validation. Will monitor similarity histograms.
Eve (Legal): Use "may have experienced" instead of "were affected". Do not promise credits in the public note without signoff; say "were evaluating suitable account credits".
Priya: Updated draft snippet: ```Hi Were reaching out about a configuration issue that may have resulted in lower-than-expected search relevance for some trial accounts this morning. Were validating a rollback now and can perform a reindex on request. Were evaluating account-level credits and will follow up with next steps and an RCA. If you notice incorrect search results please reply or contact your CS rep. 
```
Owen: Rollback completed on trial pools at 09:38 UTC. Similarity distributions returning to baseline.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-501 created, severity P3.
Nina: Good. Priya, please post as a targeted note to trial tenants and put a banner in-product for impacted trials. Also prepare an escalation email for any trials that are likely to convert (we'll prioritize those for 1:1 reindex).
Priya: Will do. Suggest offering a complimentary reindex and a waived first-month invoice for any trial that experienced issues and now indicates conversion intent. Drafting high-touch template.
Eve (Legal): Remove the specific billing wording until finance signs off. Instead say "were evaluating conversion support options".
Priya: Adjusted. Publishing public trial note now; holding high-touch email draft for Sarah/finance sign-off.
Sam: Metrics look stable. Recommend follow-up RCA with timeline, root cause (normalization change), rollout/testing gaps, and a mitigation plan to gate such encoder config changes behind canary testing.
Nina: Agreed. After RCA we will update account health scores and log feedback in the onboarding tracker. Priya, capture trial responses in the feedback survey and flag renewal-risk triggers.
Priya: On it. Sending now and scheduling 30-min office hours at 12:00 UTC for impacted trials.
Nina: Thanks all. Keep threads tight and post the final RCA doc when ready.
